testcase.name: Scenario: Retain independent panel visibility across ribbon tabs: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:152:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain independent panel visibility across ribbon tabs ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify visible ✔ And Navigate is visible on the View ribbon ✔ When the user hides Modify through the direct panel selector ✔ Then the Modify panel disappears from the 3D Model ribbon ✔ When the user switches to the View ribbon ✔ Then Navigate remains visible ✔ When the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon ✔ And the user opens the direct panel selector ✔ Then Modify is unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify in the panel selector ✔ Then the Modify panel returns to the 3D Model ribbon ✔ And the panel selector remains open with Modify checked
